# folio-templates

The PAPER profile of the files `folio_init` writes into a new folio: `paper/` holds the Lean build, lake-cache restore and blueprint workflows and the `.github/scripts` they call, written into a paper folio after the `document/` profile the tools layer keeps. Only a paper folio is given them, and the paper profile is this layer's. The id is the tools layer's `folio-templates`, so this directory is a member of that subgraph and `init-folio` finds it by id across the checkout, never by a path naming this layer. `{{assistant}}`, `{{folio}}`, `{{platform_git}}` and `{{platform_repo}}` are substituted at write time. Declared `code`: executable sources whose target is another repository. `dependents: skip` -- a folio inherits them through `folio_init`, not by owning a copy.

Part of [folio-assistant-sci](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `folio-templates`, holding `code`.

| file | what it is | used by |
